text:
Eli (marketing ops): hey team — dashboard flagged a strange overnight bump in launch impressions for APAC webinar post. can someone eyeball?
Nora: on it. which metric? impressions or unique viewers?
Eli (marketing ops): impressions peaked at ~18k between 01:30-02:15 UTC, unique viewers only +800. suggests repeat impressions or bad tag. dashboard: https://app.redwood.com/dash/launchsums?range=24h
Tomas (ads): we had a boosted promo in SG that ran 01:20-01:50 UTC. creative was the short-loop video. all paid clicks should carry utm_campaign=apac_launch_2026.
Becky (growth): CRM lead timestamps show new leads but attribution column shows "direct" for many. could be our click->lead join losing query params.
Dashbot: ingestion.process 2026-03-23T02:05Z completed. clickstream partition 2026-03-23-01 processed. 12 anomalous rows flagged: missing utm_campaign.
Eli (marketing ops): ok can we map clicks with missing utm to device/user-agent? maybe a platform strips params.
Nora: quick sample: 500 clicks in window, 470 have utm_campaign, 30 missing. user-agent shows 90% Android webview for the missing subset.
Tomas (ads): that matches a known issue where certain Android webviews strip refparams for share links. we patched browser-detection but maybe not the share generator.
Becky (growth): operational asks: 1) mark affected leads as "needs-review" in the weekly KPI spreadsheet; 2) add a dashboard annotation with link to ticket; 3) pause nurture for those IDs until we confirm.
Eli (marketing ops): will add annotation and flag in KPI doc. creating ticket: MKT-5923 "apac share-link param loss in android webview" and assigning to eng.
Tomas (ads): quick mitigation: change creative landing to append params server-side on first redirect (we can do this today). will coordinate with infra.
Nora: also recommend we run a rejoin job to recompute attribution for 01:00-03:00 window once the mapping fix is in place. that will shift CAC & channel mix in Friday deck.
Becky (growth): please include pre/post numbers in the KPI slide: total leads, leads reclassified to paid, delta CAC. stakeholders will want the headline.
Eli (marketing ops): noted. I'll add a slide footnote: "03/23 APAC impression anomaly due to Android webview param loss; reclassification pending rejoin."
Tomas (ads): filing the quick change: infra-redirect patch request created (infra-1239). ETA 6 hrs for deploy.
Dashbot: rejoin job scheduled: join-reproc-2026-03-23-02 queued after infra patch.
Becky (growth): thanks. follow-ups: Tomas 06: infra patch; Eli 06: KPI footnote & dashboard annotation; Nora 06: run rejoin and post overnight numbers.
Eli (marketing ops): will update the weekly KPI doc and ping product in Friday sync. :sparkles:
